About the Department of Biology
The Department of Biology at Tennessee Tech University offers a robust and dynamic
educational experience for students passionate about understanding the living world.
Whether you are interested in wildlife or fisheries ecology, molecular biology, or
plant or health-related careers, the Biology Department offers courses to help you
achieve your goals.
Choosing to study biology or wildlife and fisheries science at TN Tech means engaging
with a curriculum that spans fundamental and advanced topics, supported by hands-on
learning opportunities. Our students benefit from a diverse faculty with expertise
in fields including conservation biology, natural resources management, physiology,
wildlife science, microbiology, and molecular genetics, ensuring a well-rounded and
comprehensive education. The Department of Biology emphasizes experiential learning,
meaning that students gain hands-on experience in the field and laboratory and can
leave TN Tech with a foundational knowledge of techniques used by practitioners no
matter the field. Students participate in internships with the Tennessee Department
of Environment and Conservation, behind the scenes visits to the Tennessee Aquarium,
courses at the Gulf Coast Marine Lab, shadowing practitioners, and conducting primary
research with dedicated faculty mentors.
The curricula offered by our department prepare graduates for successful careers in
multiple sectors, including state and federal government agencies, environmental consulting,
agricultural and botanical research, and healthcare, as well as preparing students
for advanced studies in graduate or professional school.
Choosing to study biology at TN Tech means becoming part of a supportive community
that fosters academic and professional growth. With personalized guidance from dedicated
faculty and access to a wealth of resources, students are well-equipped to achieve
their career goals and make meaningful contributions to the field of biology.
Mission Statement
The mission of the Department of Biology at Tennessee Tech University is to provide
a solid foundation in biological sciences, fostering life-long learning and scientific
literacy through innovative teaching, research, and stewardship. We are committed
to preparing adaptable professionals for 21st-century careers in biological sciences,
health sciences, and natural resource management by offering impactful research opportunities
and promoting the exchange of ideas within a diverse and inclusive environment. Our
department aims to advance scientific understanding, support community engagement,
and contribute to local, national, and international initiatives, empowering our students
to thrive in a rapidly changing world.
